title: Install RAM in a desktop computer

steps.do: Remove the side panel from the desktop computer case
steps.done_when: The side panel is detached from the case and the motherboard inside the case is exposed

steps.do: Remove the old RAM sticks from the motherboard memory slots
steps.done_when: The motherboard memory slots are empty and the removed RAM sticks are outside the computer case

steps.do: Seat {ram_sticks} in a memory slot on the motherboard
steps.done_when: The RAM stick lies flat and fully seated in the motherboard memory slot with no gap at its contacts

steps.do: Replace the side panel on the desktop computer case
steps.done_when: The side panel covers the opening of the computer case and the internal components are no longer visible

steps.do: Plug the cables into the back of the desktop computer
steps.done_when: The power cable connector is fully inserted into the socket on the back of the closed computer case
